countries_thin_or_null: Turkmenistan — State Committee on Statistics (Turkmenstat) exists and has a legal mandate referencing international standards and SNA 2008 transition work (UNDP project), but publishes almost no verifiable primary methodology documents, detailed NA/CPI series, or IMF DSBB metadata; null/thin result is expected and data-driven

proposed_reports.title: Bureau of National Statistics of the Agency for Strategic Planning and Reforms of the Republic of Kazakhstan
proposed_reports.publisher: Agency for Strategic Planning and Reforms of the Republic of Kazakhstan
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistical office responsible for national accounts, CPI, and other official statistics; current institutional form after restructuring under the Agency for Strategic Planning and Reforms.

proposed_reports.title: National Accounts of Kazakhstan (GDP and related aggregates)
proposed_reports.description: Official national accounts and GDP estimates (production, income, expenditure approaches; flash estimates and annual series) published by the Bureau of National Statistics.

proposed_reports.title: Consumer Price Index of Kazakhstan
proposed_reports.description: Official CPI and inflation statistics (annual and monthly) covering food, non-food, and services; published by the Bureau of National Statistics.

proposed_reports.title: State Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan on Statistics (Stat.uz)
proposed_reports.publisher: State Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan on Statistics
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistical office; actively implementing statistical reforms and moving toward SDDS subscription under the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics 2020–25.

proposed_reports.title: National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic
proposed_reports.publisher: National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistical office of the Kyrgyz Republic; EAEU member state statistical authority.

proposed_reports.title: Agency on Statistics under the President of the Republic of Tajikistan
proposed_reports.publisher: Agency on Statistics under the President of the Republic of Tajikistan
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistical agency; e-GDDS participant.

proposed_reports.title: State Committee of Turkmenistan on Statistics (Turkmenstat)
proposed_reports.publisher: State Committee of Turkmenistan on Statistics
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistical body established by presidential decree and governed by the 2012 Law on Statistics; limited public release of detailed methodology or series compared with regional peers.

proposed_reports.title: National Statistics Office of Mongolia (NSO)
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistical office; SDDS subscriber since April 2019 (first country to advance from e-GDDS to SDDS via the enhanced framework).

proposed_reports.title: National Statistics Office of Georgia (Geostat)
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistical office; operates under the Law on Official Statistics and has explicit statistical cooperation obligations under the EU–Georgia Association Agreement / DCFTA.

proposed_reports.title: National Accounts of Georgia (GDP and related aggregates)
proposed_reports.description: Official national accounts and GDP series compiled by Geostat.

proposed_reports.title: Consumer Price Index of Georgia
proposed_reports.description: Official CPI compiled by Geostat using COICOP classification and weights derived from national accounts and household survey data.

proposed_reports.title: Statistical Committee of the Republic of Armenia (Armstat)
proposed_reports.publisher: Statistical Committee of the Republic of Armenia
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistical office; SDDS subscriber and EAEU member state statistical authority.

proposed_reports.title: National Accounts of Armenia
proposed_reports.publisher: Statistical Committee of the Republic of Armenia (Armstat)
proposed_reports.description: Official national accounts compiled in accordance with SNA 2008.

proposed_reports.title: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
proposed_reports.publisher: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistical office; e-GDDS participant with National Summary Data Page.

proposed_reports.title: Association Agreement between the European Union and Georgia (including DCFTA statistical cooperation provisions)
proposed_reports.description: EU–Georgia Association Agreement (with Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Area). Title V / Chapter 4 on Statistics commits the parties to progressive alignment of Georgia’s statistical system with the European Statistical System and strengthening of the national statistical system.

dependencies.basis: Kazakhstan has been an SDDS subscriber since 24 March 2003 and continues to meet SDDS requirements (confirmed by successive IMF annual observance reports).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Kazakhstan subscribed to the SDDS on March 24, 2003, and met all the SDDS requirements at the time of subscription. This report covers observance of the SDDS undertakings by Kazakhstan in 2024...

dependencies.basis: Mongolia subscribed to the SDDS on 1 April 2019 (first country to advance from e-GDDS to SDDS) and continues to observe the standard.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Mongolia subscribed to the SDDS on April 1, 2019, and met all the SDDS requirements at the time of subscription.

dependencies.basis: Armenia has been an SDDS subscriber since November 2003.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Armenia was initially a participant in the e-GDDS... In November 2003, Armenia became the 54th subscriber to the Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS).

dependencies.basis: Kyrgyz Republic has been an SDDS subscriber since 26 February 2004.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Kyrgyz Republic was initially a participant in the e-GDDS... On February 26, 2004, Kyrgyz Republic became the 57th subscriber to the Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS).

dependencies.basis: Tajikistan participates in the e-GDDS with metadata and National Summary Data Page on the IMF DSBB.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Tajikistan Summary Of Dissemination Practices (e-GDDS Data Category listings for National Accounts, Consumer Price Index, etc.).

dependencies.basis: Azerbaijan implemented the e-GDDS by publishing essential data through its National Summary Data Page (hosted by the State Statistical Committee).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Republic of Azerbaijan has implemented the recommendations of the IMF’s Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS) by publishing essential data through the National Summary Data Page (NSDP). The NSDP is hosted by Azerbaijan’s State Statistical Committee...

dependencies.basis: Uzbekistan successfully implemented the e-GDDS in May 2018 and has an explicit roadmap toward SDDS subscription under its National Strategy for the Development of Statistics 2020–25.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Uzbekistan successfully implemented the enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS) in May 2018... the authorities developed... the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics, 2020–25... including the goal of subscribing to the IMF’s SDDS.

dependencies.basis: Geostat metadata and methodological notes state that the methodological basis of the National Accounts of Georgia is the System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA-2008).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Methodological basis of the National Accounts of Georgia is a standard methodology of the System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA-2008) recommended by the United Nations, Eurostat, the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development, the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund.

dependencies.basis: Geostat CPI Technical Manual states that items in the consumer basket are grouped according to the Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP) and that weights are derived from National Accounts and the Integrated Household Survey.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Items in the basket are selected based on data from the National Accounts and the Integrated Household Survey, and are grouped according to the Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP).

dependencies.basis: Armstat metadata for national accounts state that the National Accounts of Armenia are compiled in accordance with the fundamental classifications, definitions and concepts of the System of National Accounts (SNA-2008).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The National Accounts of Armenia are compiled in accordance with the fundamental classifications, definitions and concepts of the System of National Accounts (SNA-2008), as well as other methodological bases.

dependencies.basis: The EU–Georgia Association Agreement (Title V, Chapter 4 on Statistics) and subsequent Geostat / EU documents explicitly commit Georgia to progressive alignment of its statistical system with the European Statistical System and strengthening of the national statistical system; Geostat and EU twinning/implementation reports cite these obligations as governing statistical cooperation and approximation.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Twinning project is pursuant to the provisions envisaged under Chapter 4 (Statistics), title V (economic cooperation) of the Association Agreement between the European Union and Georgia. Precisely, Chapter 4 focuses on statistical cooperation and includes almost all key areas of statistical production with the view of its gradual approximation of the EU statistical standards. Articles 286-289 stipulate, “Further strengthening the capacity of the national statistical system” and “progressive alignment of the statistical system of Georgia with the European Statistical System”...
